```{r}
# ── F.2 Likelihood of Trail Use with Supplemental Funding ────────────────────

summary_data_f2 <- mlogit_clean %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Zipverified) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(Likelihood_Trail.Use, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rating   = sd(Likelihood_Trail.Use, na.rm = TRUE),
    n           = n(),
    se          = sd_rating / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower    = mean_rating - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper    = mean_rating + 1.96 * se,
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Zipverified = factor(Zipverified,
                         levels = c("Resident", "Tourist"),
                         labels = c("Residents", "Tourists"))
  )

f2 <- ggplot(summary_data_f2, 
             aes(x = Zipverified, y = mean_rating, fill = Zipverified)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", mean_rating)),
    vjust  = -1.5,
    size   = 3,
    color  = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Residents" = "#c87620",
      "Tourists"  = "#5992c6"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 10),
    breaks = seq(0, 10, 2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How likely are you to use trails that require a user fee mechanism?",
    x     = "",
    y     = "Mean likelihood rating (1 = very unlikely, 10 = very likely)",
    fill  = ""   # removes "Zipverified" legend title
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, 
                                      size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", 
                                      hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position    = "none",   # x-axis labels already identify groups
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  filename    = "Figure_F2_LikelihoodTrailUse.tiff",
  plot        = f2,
  width       = 120,
  height      = 100,
  units       = "mm",
  dpi         = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_F2_LikelihoodTrailUse.pdf",
  plot     = f2,
  width    = 120,
  height   = 100,
  units    = "mm"
)

print(f2)
rm(summary_data_f2)
```
